methodology: Fundamental valuation re-rating: Target Price = current EPS x fair sector-median P/E (bounded within 0.75x-1.5x of the stock's own P/E, capped at 12-40% potential upside, to avoid extreme/unreliable projections). Buy Price = current market price. Only profitable (positive EPS/PE), reasonably liquid (Market Cap > Rs 1,000 Cr) and quality (ROE >= 10%) companies are considered.
disclaimer: Educational/informational only. This is an automated, rules-based screen, NOT personalized investment advice and NOT a guarantee of returns. Past accuracy of a strategy does not predict future performance. Please do your own research and consult a SEBI-registered financial advisor before investing.
